items.title: Payment deadline stated on the offer letter (recommended NOT to pay)
items.computation: The letter states a fixed calendar date, 01.12.2026, as the payment deadline. 2026-12-01 is a Tuesday, not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in NRW, so no shift under § 193 BGB is needed. Note, however, that the letter itself states 'Dieses Schreiben ist ein Angebot. Mit Ihrer Zahlung nehmen Sie es an; ein Vertrag kommt erst durch die Zahlung zustande.' This means it is an unsolicited commercial offer, not a binding invoice for an existing debt — there is no legal obligation to pay by this or any date.

warnings: This letter is styled as an invoice ('Rechnung') but explicitly states it is only an offer ('Angebot') and that a contract would only come into existence if payment is made — this is a known scam pattern (similar to fake 'Gewerbeauskunft-Zentrale'/private register solicitations) targeting property owners with look-alike official-sounding names like 'Grundstücksregister'.

The letter itself admits the entry 'erfolgt im privaten Verzeichnis des Absenders und steht in keinem Zusammenhang mit dem amtlichen Grundbuch' — i.e. it has no connection to the official German land registry (Grundbuch) and paying provides no legal benefit.

Recommend the recipient does NOT pay this invoice and verifies the sender's legitimacy independently before taking any action; this appears to be an unsolicited scam/phishing-style solicitation rather than a genuine obligation.
